Customer Support Specialist (Remote — EMEA)
Acme Software · Fully remote, work from anywhere in EMEA

We build scheduling software used by 40,000 small businesses. Our support team answers by chat and email using Zendesk.

What you'll do:
- Answer customer chats and emails (around 40-60 conversations a day)
- Keep our CSAT above 90%
- Write and update help-center articles
- Work European hours (CET ± 2)

Requirements:
- 2+ years in customer support or customer service
- Fluent written English (C1 or better)
- Experience with Zendesk or a similar ticketing tool
- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace

Nice to have:
- A second European language
- Experience with SaaS products

Salary: €2,200 - €2,600 gross per month depending on experience.
We hire worldwide via Deel as contractor or EOR.
